'''Ice Plants'''<ref name="Secrets">''[[Super Empire Strikes Back Official Game Secrets]]''</ref> were a type of [[Plant/Legends|vegetation]] found on the [[Temperature/Legends|frigid]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. They were known to attack anybody they saw as a threat.<ref name="SSW 2" />
